description_en: 1+1 apartment for sale on Zogu Boulevard I. The apartment has a surface area of ​​61.3m2, it is organized in a living room, a separate kitchen with a dining area, a bedroom and a toilet. It is located only 3 minutes from Skenderbej Square, the area has many facilities such as shopping centers, bars, restaurants, supermarkets, etc., which makes this apartment a very good investment opportunity. For more information or a visit to the property, you are welcome to contact us!
